beats.summary: Jim and Pam reveal they are dating to the office.

evidence.snippet: Toby: Alright everyone, look, it, alright my complaint was about Jim and Pam.
Jim: Ummm… yup. Yes, we are.

beats.summary: Michael initially questions Toby about a PDA memo but then celebrates Jim and Pam's relationship.

evidence.snippet: Michael (reads memo): I just want to remind everyone about the company rules involving PDA or public displays of affection.
Michael: Oh kay, mind is exploding. Get over here. Come on. Come here. Okay, okay, stand up. OK, here we go.

beats.summary: Dwight gives Angela a replacement cat named Garbage after destroying her previous cat Sprinkles.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: It's a feral barn cat. I trapped him last night and I'm giving him to you as a replacement cat for the one I destroyed.
Angela: I don't want Garbage! I want Sprinkles!

beats.summary: Ryan returns to the office as the new boss and demands respect.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam inquire about company policy on dating and whether they need to sign any forms.
